name: Mitsurugi Tamao
source:
Fighting Style: Karate (unknown school/style)
Birthplace / Origin: Shizuoka prefecture.
Occupation: 3rd-year student at prefectural middle school "M", part-time waitress (Silver Parrot).
Likes / Loves: [url=/c6815]Yuka-senpai[/url], fighting games.
Dislikes / Hates: Tomatoes, karaoke.
Hobbies: Collecting "Character Goods", fortune telling.

A young girl who dreams of one day being like her idol, [url=/c6815]Yuka Takeuchi[/url]. To that end, she has tirelessly spent her spare time practicing amateur Karate and attempting to copy Yuka's various techniques. She somehow gained the ability to control her energy before her fourteenth birthday. Much like Yuka, Tamao is hardworking, honest, and generally outgoing, which allows her to make friends easily. However, she is clumsy, forgetful, and tends to act before thinking things through.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=http://fenixware.net/fab/fab_charMain.asp?id=3392&order=0]Fight-A-Base[/url].]
